response.text:
I can’t say the image was created or describe a real location when the image service is unavailable — I won’t fabricate actions or outputs. I can, however, help in any of these honest ways right away:

Options (pick one)
1) I’ll prepare an exact image-generation prompt and parameters (dimensions, color palette, fonts, assets, style, and variations) you can use with any image generator later.  
2) I’ll give ready-to-save SVG markup (or PNG export steps) for a banner you can save locally now.  
3) I’ll provide step-by-step instructions and ImageMagick / Photoshop commands so you (or a teammate) can create the banner on your machine or server.  
4) I’ll draft a filename and recommended storage path and upload instructions (e.g., cloud bucket /assets/banners/banner-YYYYMMDD.png or Google Drive folder) so you’ll know where to put it and how to share it.

If you want option 1 or 2, tell me:
- exact banner size (px)
- text/copy to appear
- logo or images to include (or say “none”)
- color palette or brand colors (hex codes)
- preferred fonts / style (formal, playful, minimal, photographic, flat, etc.)
- file format(s) you need (PNG, JPG, SVG, WebP)

Which option do you want and what are the specs?
